comparison.objective: Place and hold a nail upright while another arm drives it into a wooden post.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanual nail stabilization, timed hammering, release once self-supporting, and collision avoidance.
comparison.success_condition: Nail driven more than 4 cm; any arm-arm or hammer-controlled-arm contact scores zero.
comparison.reason: It shares mandrel-like stabilization plus hammer impacts, but tests progressive fastener penetration and hand-clearance timing. It does not test fracture at a notch, protection of a retained threaded insert, tool withdrawal without snagging, or recovery of loose fragments.

review_notes.purpose: Early concrete near-neighbor retrieval only.
